properties.query:
let DomainWorkationLogon= SecurityEvent
| where EventID == "4624"
| where WorkstationName !in ("-","") and IpAddress != "-" 
| where WorkstationName !startswith "WIN-"
| summarize DomWSLogonTime=min(TimeGenerated), DomWorkStationName= make_set(WorkstationName),DomLogonAccount=make_set(Account),DomLogonType=make_set(LogonType),DomLogonProcess=make_set(ProcessName),DomLogonActivity=make_set(Activity)  by IpAddress;
let NonDomainWorkationLogin=
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == "4624"
|  where WorkstationName !in ("-","") and IpAddress != "-"
| where WorkstationName startswith "WIN-"
| summarize NonDomWSLogonTime=max(TimeGenerated), NonDomWorkStationName= make_set(WorkstationName),NonDomLogonAccount=make_set(Account),NonDomLogonType=make_set(LogonType),NonDomLogonProcess=make_set(ProcessName),NonDomLogonActivity=make_set(Activity) by IpAddress;
NonDomainWorkationLogin | join DomainWorkationLogon on IpAddress
| project-away IpAddress1
| project-reorder DomWSLogonTime,DomWorkStationName,NonDomWSLogonTime,NonDomWorkStationName
| where datetime_diff( "Minute",NonDomWSLogonTime,DomWSLogonTime)  > 0
